written.headline: OpenAI launches LifeVal benchmark for AI assistance with everyday tasks
written.summary: OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a benchmark that measures how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks such as finding childcare, managing finances, and handling government paperwork. The benchmark aims to evaluate AI performance on real‑world assistance tasks.

written.headline: Lumen and Microsoft expand co‑selling to deliver AI‑ready enterprise networks
written.summary: Lumen Technologies and Microsoft announced an expanded collaboration to help enterprises connect data, applications and infrastructure for AI workloads. Lumen will bring its cloud networking and application connectivity capabilities to Azure and the Microsoft Marketplace.
